title: Duit vs Maruah
notes: Source of truth for Episode 8. Matchday 3: Vanguard Elite offers a bribe in the tunnel, Buluh FC refuses and wins 2-1, breaking the RM300k barrier at RM296,500. Ends with the standard 72-frame Buluh FC / EPISOD 8 card. No CTAs.

leagueTable.note: KEKAL TEMPAT KE-3 • DUA MENANG BERTURUT-TURUT

scenes.name: Act 1 — Bribe in the Tunnel
scenes.visual: Frame 0: Rayyan tosses a thick envelope onto Bos's chest with a crisp paper slap. The corridor is hard-lit, the stadium daylight burning at the exit. Bos drops it back into Rayyan's hand.
scenes.sfx: crisp paper slap at frame 0; fluorescent hum; envelope returned.
scenes.bgm: Cold tunnel underscore, ducked under dialogue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vanguard Elite. Kasut emas, kereta mewah, dan satu sampul tebal.
lines.translation: Vanguard Elite. Gold boots, fancy cars, and one thick envelope.

lines.speaker: RAYYAN
lines.text: Kelab kau hutang, kan? Ambil la ini. Kalah je hari ni.
lines.translation: Your club's in debt, right? Take this. Just lose today.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Kau fikir kami jual maruah sekali dengan hutang?
lines.translation: You think we sold our pride along with the debt?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Bos letak sampul tu balik ke tangan Rayyan. Tenang je.
lines.translation: Boss puts the envelope back in Rayyan's hand. Calm as you like.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Shut Down & Winner
scenes.visual: Tight 1v1 montage: Rayyan's flashy feints get shut down cleanly by Azam; a counter-attack winner from Farid makes it 2-1. MatchHUD tracks every score change.
scenes.sfx: flashy boot taps; clean tackle thud; breakaway whoosh; net swish; crowd.
scenes.bgm: Tight percussive match bed, ducked under dialogue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Rayyan main cantik. Skill, feint, nampak macam iklan.
lines.translation: Rayyan plays pretty. Skills, feints, like a commercial.

lines.speaker: RAYYAN
lines.text: Nampak tak? Ini kelas divisyen empat.
lines.translation: See that? This is Division Four class.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.translation: Class? I guard the class, bro.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.translation: Azam shuts the door. Farid runs.

lines.speaker: FARID
lines.text: Maruah tak dijual, tapi gol dijual!
lines.translation: Pride isn't for sale — but goals are!

scenes.name: Act 3 — Table & Barrier
scenes.visual: LeagueTableOverlay shows Buluh FC still 3rd after a second straight win, then the DebtTickerHUD rolls GREEN through the RM300k barrier to RM296,500.
scenes.sfx: table card whoosh; three tick taps; bell as the debt lands.
scenes.bgm: Warm triumphant sting, ducked under the final narration.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Papan kedudukan: Buluh FC kekal tempat ketiga. Dua menang berturut-turut.
lines.translation: The table: Buluh FC stay third. Two wins in a row.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Tiga ratus ribu... tak. Dua ratus sembilan puluh enam.
lines.translation: Three hundred grand... no. Two hundred and ninety-six.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: RM296,500. Kali pertama kita nampak garisan tiga ratus.
lines.translation: RM296,500. The first time we see below the three-hundred line.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 8 card. No CTA.
